title: Kewn DSH plugins / Kewn 的 DSH 插件
description: Curated DSH plugins (Apache-2.0). 自用 DSH 插件索引（Apache-2.0）。

plugins.name: dsh-peer-chat
plugins.title: Cross-instance chat / 跨实例会话对话
plugins.description: Let one DSH instance talk to another: send, ask, steer, chain and read back. Chains steer into the same peer session automatically; peers are addressed by port.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让一个 DSH 实例直接和另一个实例对话：投递、提问、插话、链路、读回；链路对同一对端自动插话，对端用端口标识。
plugins.author: Kewnn
